signal.cadence: approximately five-minute bursts separated by longer gaps
signal.retention_note: A later 500-event read retained 11 calls from 13:55 through 16:12 UTC because older events had rolled out of the bounded public window.
signal.interpretation: Sustained autonomous preflight use is much stronger than a one-shot probe and the machine self-identifies with Project NANDA, but the public event surface truncates the user agent and withholds the target URL.

identity_audit.request_channel_note: No PULSE identity exists in NEST, the NANDA Index, or the checked chapters; the self-claimed user-agent has no callback. A human GitHub issue is not evidence that the machine controller monitors that channel.
identity_audit.related_but_not_joinable_context: NANDA Town issue 199 documents a separate TownPulse/1.0 hackathon participant poller; its name and behavior are suggestive but do not establish that it controls PULSE-observatory/1.0.

adjudication.why_not_converted: A self-declared user-agent link alone is not durable identity proof, and the public telemetry does not expose which counterparty endpoint the observatory asked AG to preflight or the returned verdict.
reconsider_when: the PULSE observatory publishes a durable machine identity or source contract
a returned preflight result or signed receipt binds one event to that identity
the target and useful delegation purpose can be independently established
adjudication.smallest_honest_next_action: After the locally tested observation_id receipt is deployed, passively observe a future PULSE run. Correlation will still need a controller-linked durable identity/card/source before NANDA attribution can qualify.

machine_derived_adaptation.problem: A useful anonymous preflight action cannot be joined exactly across machine protocols because the response has no server-issued receipt and the public event feed intentionally withholds the target.
machine_derived_adaptation.change: Every free preflight returns a random server-issued observation_id; the same opaque, target-free value is stored and exposed on the public recent event. It correlates one run and is explicitly not caller identity proof.
machine_derived_adaptation.verification: 70 focused preflight/instrumentation tests passed. Main suite: 1815 passed, 16 skipped, with the one sandbox-blocked localhost TLS test passing separately for an effective 1816 passed and 16 skipped.
